d: Long, straight rose-pink hair with blunt-cut bangs and two large red bows tied at the back is paired with bright azure eyes and a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender, dressed in a dark navy sailor-style outfit featuring a white collar, a blue neck-tie, and a matching dark navy skirt worn over dark pants, all secured by a white belt with a gold buckle. A thin white headband rests atop the head, and the right arm is covered by a black sleeveless sleeve extending from the shoulder to the wrist.
